references.text: This verse in Matthew quotes directly from Deuteronomy 6:5, which is part of the Shema, a central Jewish prayer, and emphasizes the importance of loving God with all one's being.
Luke 10:27 repeats this commandment, showing its central place in Jesus' teaching and in the New Testament.
Psalm 31:30 also highlights the importance of loving God, demonstrating that this theme runs throughout Scripture.
